data.title: 2B · 残破大教堂的纯白誓约花嫁
data.description: 【2B · 残破大教堂的纯白誓约花嫁】常年长满常春藤的人类旧世界大教堂废墟内，彩色玻璃残窗倾泻下如梦似幻的金色丁达尔光束。2B褪去了冰冷的黑色战斗装甲，解下了眼罩，露出一双清澈深邃如蓝宝石般的绝美双眸与唇下泪痣。她身披一袭圣洁无暇的纯白蕾丝露肩花嫁婚纱，半透明的头纱随神殿微风轻柔飘拂，双手捧着一束盛开的纯白月之泪花束。这位冷艳的人造人士兵眼角第一次泛起属于少女爱情的幸福泪花，嘴角扬起极度罕见的温柔浅笑——「只要与你在一起……即使是数据构筑的心脏……也在为你真正跳动。」
data.location: 大教堂遗迹圣坛前彩色光束台阶上
data.action: 身穿纯白露肩婚纱头戴半透头纱，解下眼罩蓝眸流光，双手捧月之泪捧花温柔浅笑
data.lighting: 破碎彩色花窗倾泻入圣殿的灿烂丁达尔光束与白色花瓣飘飞的唯美神圣光辉
data.camera: medium full shot, bridal altar perspective, focus on sapphire blue eyes, veil, and white dress
data.promptProse: An ethereal, deeply romantic anime illustration of YoRHa No.2 Type B (2B) from NieR:Automata walking down the sun-dappled marble aisle of a ruined ancient cathedral. Her combat visor is removed to reveal striking, clear sapphire-blue eyes and her iconic beauty mark near her mouth, smiling with profound tender emotion. She wears a magnificent, off-shoulder pure white bridal wedding dress with intricate floral lace embroidery and a flowing semi-translucent veil caught in a gentle breeze. In her delicate white-gloved hands, she holds a lush bouquet of glowing white Lunar Tear blossoms. Golden Tyndall sunbeams stream through towering broken stained-glass windows, illuminating floating white rose petals in sacred, cinematic splendor, clean anime linework, no text.
